messages:
nora: Filing an odd token accounting case — customer hit a route quota just after a streaming reconnect + toolcall truncation. Looks like provisional and confirmed diverged and UI showed a weird negative provisional for a short window.
kyle: can you paste the timeline?
nora: yes. quick clipped logs below. sequence: initial stream emitted prefix P (credited), toolcall truncated suffix S, reconnect caused resumed stream which emitted overlapping prefix P', sampler logged both, aggregator tried dedupe but ledger commit applied an adjustment that made provisional dip negative in the console for ~7s. customer saw throttle during that window.
anita: that matches a race we've seen when truncation and reconnect interleave. sampling still reports tokens; ledger later applies a "dedupe adjustment" that reduces confirmed, making provisional = sample - confirmed go negative if sample hasn't aged out.
nora: logs:
```
[14:02:10.100] sample sess=ord-77 prefix=60 suffix=12 toolcall=0 provisional_tokens=72
[14:02:10.205] toolcall: truncate suffix=12 -> record truncated
[14:02:10.300] network: reconnect, resume-offset=60
[14:02:10.305] sample sess=ord-77 prefix=60 suffix=0 provisional_tokens=60 (duplicate)
[14:02:37.502] ledger commit sess=ord-77 confirmed_tokens=0 adj=-60 (dedupe)
```

kyle: how did quota fire? route-level quota checks use provisional_cost, right?
anita: yes. provisional_cost is derived from sampler tokens * price estimate. If sampler double-counts prefix then provisional_cost temporarily higher. If ledger reduces confirmed after, provisional can go negative until sampling window clears. Our quota enforcement didn't account for transient negative provisional and clamps only at account-level, not route/session.
priya: ops impact: customer was throttled for ~10s and called support. We need a low-risk UX fix fast.
nora: suggested short-term fixes: 1) clamp per-session provisional shown in UI to >=0 to avoid alarming the customer, 2) avoid using provisional when it's negative for quota decisions (treat negative as 0), 3) add console tooltip clarifying provisional is an estimate and may change after reconciliation.
kyle: implementation note: clamping in UI is low-risk. But for quota enforcement behavior, treating negative provisional as zero could mask real negative adjustments like refunds. How do we distinguish?
anita: refunds are flagged in ledger with refund=true and come with a separate ledger_event; the negative provisional here is not a refund, it's a dedupe adjustment recorded as adj in the commit log. We can disambiguate by source field: ledger adjustments from dedupe vs explicit refunds. Quota enforcement can ignore dedupe adjustments until confirmed by a refund event.
nora: operational ask: add a runbook line for CS to explain provisional blips and a temporary customer-facing message we can paste.
nora: ops-bot created BI-11456 "Clamp per-session provisional and doc runsheet" assigned to @priya P2.
priya: I'll draft the CS message. Also will add an alert that surfaces when provisional_delta < 0 for >5s so SRE can triage.
console-bot: Created ticket ENG-3219 "Sampler/ledger race: prevent negative provisional from causing throttles" assigned @kyle, priority P1.
kyle: long-term fix: add a monotonic sample watermark per session and emit explicit de-dupe markers to the aggregator so it can retroactively remove stale samples instead of letting sample_total remain until TTL. Also change quota calc to ignore provisional deltas that originate from pre-dedupe epochs for X seconds.
anita: we should also test with toolcall truncation + reconnect + model-swap permutations. add unit + integration tests to the provisional smoothing suite.
kyle: agreed. I'll sketch an implementation: 1) router emits sample_epoch header when resuming; 2) aggregator uses epoch to keep separate buffers and only merge when epoch stable > 5s; 3) ledger will emit dedupe_event tag that aggregator consumes to drop stale tokens immediately.
priya: timeline: I'll ship the UI clamp + tooltip today as a hotfix, Kyle will own ENG-3219 for the aggregator/ledger work.
nora: thanks. please ping CS when UI patch is staged. also assigning myself to verify affected customer after deploy. :thumbsup:
